name: matomoUrl
help: Base URL of your Matomo instance, e.g. https://analytics.example.com

name: jsPath
displayName: Public path of the tracker JS
help: Path on your server-side GTM domain that serves matomo.js. Use a neutral path such as /js/app.js to avoid ad blockers.

name: trackerPath
displayName: Public path of the tracking endpoint
help: Path that receives tracking hits. Set the same value in setTrackerUrl() of your Matomo snippet.

name: allowedOrigins
help: Comma-separated list, e.g. https://www.example.com, https://shop.example.com. Leave empty to accept any origin.

name: allowedSiteIds
help: Comma-separated list of exact site IDs, e.g. 1, 3 (no wildcards). Hits for other site IDs are dropped. Leave empty to accept any site, like Matomo itself.

valueValidators.errorMessage: Use numeric site IDs separated by commas, e.g. 1, 3

name: mtmCacheMinutes
displayName: Matomo Tag Manager container cache duration (minutes)
help: Published containers are cached for this duration. Preview containers (_preview) are never cached.
